Retain first gnas/place to stay; HGM 10288 explicitly attests this noun phrase. The original first gnas lies before kyi blos; later gnas is not allowed to inherit this range.

Retain inflected blos/thinks whole. Original HGM blo 12986 includes thinks; blos 24294 instead gives intent, contrary evidence retained. Gnas kyi blos describes the thought of a dwelling; the exact local English verbalizes that thought. It is not a universal definition of blos, and the inseparable s is intact.

Retain second gnas/home after challenge to both angles' agreement. The gnas-par-byed light-verb construction expresses residence; in the particular English light-verb idiom makes his home, gnas carries residence/home content and byed carries makes. HGM 10288 explicitly includes home, 12837 includes makes, and 23878 gives the complete makes his home. ILL:2331 recasts the second predicate as reside, while C08:179/190/193 show other gnas-par-byed functions: neither makes a universal home equivalent. Full-span makes his home would overcapture supplied his, so the two contextually supported atoms are retained without it.

Retain byed pa/makes in this residence light-verb idiom (HGM 12837 makes; whole 23878 makes his home). This is actual present English makes aligned to the overt Tibetan light verb, not an invented independent act of manufacturing. Unlike 251 wash, the English explicitly has a light verb here. Par is a constructional link omitted for distributed relation, and supplied his remains unwrapped.

material_omissions: PROVISIONAL machine alignment reconciled by Codex (gpt-6-astra). The two gnas occurrences are distinct: the first names the perceived place to stay; the second carries the residence content home in GMR's makes his home idiom. Byed pa supplies its light verb makes, while par links the Tibetan predicate and is omitted. This local compositional match does not claim that every gnas par byed pa means making a home. The complete HGM glossary idiom and the separate gnas/home and byed pa/makes attestations support the split; his is supplied and stays unwrapped. De nyid owns this same; water supplies the antecedent from C05:249. Blos stays intact and owns thinks in the nominal-to-verbal recast, despite its separate glossary's intent reading. La sogs is the attested closing gesture or such and licenses initial or. Pas is retained whole as agentive marking with no separately alignable English word; it is not split into pa and s. The initial la and kyi are omitted as distributed relations. Final dang links onward in the source series; it is not assigned the English interior and. An, on the other hand, of, water, as a, and, his and there remain unwrapped. All original wording is preserved; no new erratum and no hgm_gloss promotion.
